verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms mise publishes an llms.txt at https://mise.jdx.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200), with structured, curated content ('Start here' section linking Getting started, etc.). That is exactly what an agent can be pointed at. However, per-page markdown variants are not served: getting-started.html.md returned 404. Missing for 10: per-page .md doc variants (probe 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt or deeper agent-specific doc guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use of these docs.
